mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 4.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers equity market sentiment shifts, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) fails to predict negative returns: SPX returns are positive in >60% of cases when both series decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, INDPRO declines do not produce negative SPX returns: 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive real GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strengthening economic fundamentals that support corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth fails to predict positive returns: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of positive growth instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt imminent Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) fails to predict negative returns: SPX returns are positive in >60% of cases when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals sector weakness that dampens consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In housing recovery regimes, HOUST declines do not produce negative SPX returns: 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.
